Lucy Cohen (Lucy in the Garden} came twice for 2 x6 hours a day.  I was really pleased with her and she did a wonderful job, very professional but she felt it was a bit to far to travel on a weekly basis. About the same time Gema Gardening came to see the garden and accepted the job but this experience was just the opposite. What she actually said she would do didn't really happen in reality.  The garden looked worse than when she started and was left in a terrible mess.  All the slate removed from the garden has just been left at the side of the house.  She always wanted paying up front which I don't usually do. I have paid out £4,850 and can see little for it. No invoices, receipts for the money she had received by cheque apart from the first one.  This experience has really got to me,
It is 1 star for Gem Gardening and 5star for Lucy in the Garden.

text:
Not what it used to be. Needed gutter repair and chose a local roofer. Checkatrade suggested I add a couple of others, which it auto suggested, as getting 3 quotes is a good idea. Immediately one of the "others" contacted me (within 30 seconds). On 3 photos of the gutter, no site visit and < 10 mins later I'd been quoted £700. The local roofer I'd initially chosen received the same photos, said he needed a site visit and did the work for £90 2 days later. I told him about the £700. He explained Checkatrade is expensive for traders (which gets passed onto us) and seems to have a list of companies who quote "greedy" sums in the hope they get the work. I should complain about the £700 quote but in his experience nothing will happen.

In the future I'll use Checkatrade like Booking.com. A place to do an initial scan of what's available, then do my own checks online and make direct contact.
llm_reason: Review describes a customer's experience with finding and comparing quotes via Checkatrade, highlighting poor pricing and provider quality.
